set.body:
PURPOSE

Resolve the cross-page relation design with executable evidence before committing the product to a metaphor. Compare the Codex portal/lane treatment with a synchronized structural view using the same typed fixture and the same provider-supplied identities.

SCOPE

- Use one current, typed War-of-the-Ghosts fixture containing repeated or cross-page endpoints.
- Build the smallest runnable comparison between: A) Codex continuation portals and relation lanes; and B) a synchronized overview/detail structural presentation.
- Hold input identities, evidence, focus, selection, layer requests, and textual content constant across both treatments.
- Record the comparison and the chosen contract as a StoryAtlas decision artifact; do not add narrative semantics to Intaglio.

ACCEPTANCE

- Both treatments render from the same typed source without copied story text or hand-authored semantic coordinates.
- A reader can trace every tested relation to named endpoints across the page boundary using keyboard and pointer paths.
- Focus, selection, suppression, missingness, off-projection state, and evidence descent remain inspectable and testable.
- Meaning is not conveyed by hue alone; the browser court includes DPR 2 captures, 200 percent zoom, computed contrast/non-colour checks, and textual-twin checks.
- The decision records observable task criteria, known limitations, and why the selected presentation wins those criteria.

EVIDENCE LIMIT

This is a Tier-1 executable design comparison, not a human-factors study. It must not claim usability, comprehension, or scientific validity beyond the implemented fixture and courts.
set.title: Compare cross-page relation presentations on one typed fixture
